                        <div>
                           <div>
                              <p class="oj-doc-ti oj-quotation-ti" id="d1e489-196-1">‘ANNEX III</p>
                              <p class="oj-doc-ti oj-quotation-ti">ACTIVITY COVERED BY CHAPTER IVa</p>
                              <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" class="oj-table">
                                 <col width="69%"/>
                                 <col width="31%"/>
                                 <tbody>
                                    <tr class="oj-table">
                                       <td valign="top" class="oj-table"  >
                                          <p class="oj-tbl-hdr">Activity</p>
                                       </td>
                                       <td valign="top" class="oj-table"  >
                                          <p class="oj-tbl-hdr">Greenhouse gases</p>
                                       </td>
                                    </tr>
                                    <tr class="oj-table">
                                       <td valign="top" class="oj-table"  >
                                          <p class="oj-tbl-txt">Release for consumption of fuels which are used for combustion in the buildings, road transport and additional sectors. This activity shall not include:</p>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(a)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">the release for consumption of fuels used in the activities listed in Annex I, except if used for combustion in the activities of transport of greenhouse gases for geological storage as set out in the table, row twenty seven, of that Annex or if used for combustion in installations excluded under Article 27a;</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(b)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">the release for consumption of fuels for which the emission factor is zero;</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(c)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">the release for consumption of hazardous or municipal waste used as fuel.</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                          <p class="oj-tbl-txt">The buildings and road transport sectors shall correspond to the following sources of emissions, defined in the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, with the necessary modifications to those definitions as follows:</p>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(a)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">Combined Heat and Power Generation (CHP) (source category code 1A1a ii) and Heat Plants (source category code 1A1a iii), insofar as they produce heat for categories under points (c) and (d) of this paragraph, either directly or through district heating networks;</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                       </td>
                                       <td valign="top" class="oj-table"  >
                                          <p class="oj-tbl-txt">Carbon dioxide</p>
                                       </td>
                                    </tr>
                                    <tr class="oj-table">
                                       <td valign="top" class="oj-table"  >
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(b)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">Road Transportation (source category code 1A3b), excluding the use of agricultural vehicles on paved roads;</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(c)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">Commercial / Institutional (source category code 1A4a);</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(d)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">Residential (source category code 1A4b).</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                          <p class="oj-tbl-txt">Additional sectors shall correspond to the following sources of emissions, defined in the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories:</p>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(a)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">Energy Industries (source category code 1A1), excluding the categories defined under the second paragraph, point (a), of this Annex;</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                          <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                             <col width="4%"/>
                                             <col width="96%"/>
                                             <tbody>
                                                <tr>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">(b)</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                   <td valign="top"  >
                                                      <p class="oj-normal">Manufacturing Industries and Construction (source category code 1A2).</p>
                                                   </td>
                                                </tr>
                                             </tbody>
                                          </table>
                                       </td>
                                       <td valign="top" class="oj-table"  >
                                          <p class="oj-normal"> </p>
                                       </td>
                                    </tr>
                                 </tbody>
                              </table>
                           </div>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                           <div>
                              <p class="oj-doc-ti oj-quotation-ti" id="d1e578-196-1">ANNEX IIIa</p>
                              <p class="oj-doc-ti oj-quotation-ti">ADJUSTMENT OF LINEAR REDUCTION FACTOR IN ACCORDANCE WITH ARTICLE 30c(2)</p>
                              <div class="oj-enumeration-spacing">
                                 <p style="display: inline;">1.   </p>
                                 <p style="display: inline;">
                                    <span>If the average emissions reported under Chapter IVa for the years 2024 to 2026 are more than 2 % higher compared to the value of the 2025 quantity defined in accordance with Article 30c(1), and if those differences are not due to the difference of less than 5 % between the emissions reported under Chapter IVa and the inventory data of 2025 Union greenhouse gas emissions from UNFCCC source categories for the sectors covered under Chapter IVa, the linear reduction factor shall be calculated by adjusting the linear reduction factor referred to in Article 30c(1).</span>
                                 </p>
                              </div>
                              <div class="oj-enumeration-spacing">
                                 <p style="display: inline;">2.   </p>
                                 <span>The adjusted linear reduction factor in accordance with point 1 shall be determined as follows:</span>
                                 <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <col width="100%"/>
                                    <tbody>
                                       <tr>
                                          <td valign="top"  >
                                             <p class="oj-normal">LRF<span class="oj-sub">adj</span> = 100%* [MRV<span class="oj-sub">[2024-2026]</span> – (ESR<span class="oj-sub">[2024]</span> - 6* LRF[<span class="oj-sub">2024</span>]* ESR<span class="oj-sub">[2024]</span>)]/ (5* MRV<span class="oj-sub">[2024-2026]</span>), where,</p>
                                          </td>
                                       </tr>
                                    </tbody>
                                 </table>
                                 <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <col width="100%"/>
                                    <tbody>
                                       <tr>
                                          <td valign="top"  >
                                             <p class="oj-normal">LRF<span class="oj-sub">adj</span> is the adjusted linear reduction factor;</p>
                                          </td>
                                       </tr>
                                    </tbody>
                                 </table>
                                 <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <col width="100%"/>
                                    <tbody>
                                       <tr>
                                          <td valign="top"  >
                                             <p class="oj-normal">MRV<span class="oj-sub">[2024-2026]</span> is the average of verified emissions under Chapter IVa for the years 2024 to 2026;</p>
                                          </td>
                                       </tr>
                                    </tbody>
                                 </table>
                                 <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <col width="100%"/>
                                    <tbody>
                                       <tr>
                                          <td valign="top"  >
                                             <p class="oj-normal">ESR<span class="oj-sub">[2024]</span> is the value of 2024 emissions defined in accordance with Article 30c(1) for the sectors covered under Chapter IVa;</p>
                                          </td>
                                       </tr>
                                    </tbody>
                                 </table>
                                 <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                    <col width="100%"/>
                                    <tbody>
                                       <tr>
                                          <td valign="top"  >
                                             <p class="oj-normal">LRF[<span class="oj-sub">2024</span>] is the linear reduction factor referred to in Article 30c(1).</p>
                                          </td>
                                       </tr>
                                    </tbody>
                                 </table>
                              </div>
                           </div>
                        </div>
                        ’;</td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top"  >
                        <p class="oj-normal">(4)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top"  >
                        <p class="oj-normal">Annex IV to Directive 2003/87/EC is amended as follows:</p>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="96%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">(a)</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">in Part A, the section ‘Calculation’ is amended as follows:</p>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(i)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">in the third paragraph, the last sentence ‘The emission factor for biomass shall be zero.’ is replaced by the following:</p>
                                                <p class="oj-normal">
                                                ‘The emission factor for biomass that complies with the sustainability criteria and greenhouse gas emission-saving criteria for the use of biomass established by Directive (EU) 2018/2001, with any necessary adjustments for application under this Directive, as set out in the implementing acts referred to in Article 14 of this Directive, shall be zero.’;</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(ii)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the fifth paragraph is replaced by the following:</p>
                                                <p class="oj-normal">
                                                ‘Default oxidation factors developed pursuant to Directive 2010/75/EU shall be used, unless the operator can demonstrate that activity-specific factors are more accurate.’;</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="96%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">(b)</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">in Part B, section ‘Monitoring of carbon dioxide emissions’, fourth paragraph, the last sentence ‘The emission factor for biomass shall be zero.’ is replaced by the following:</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">
                                    ‘The emission factor for biomass that complies with the sustainability criteria and greenhouse gas emission-saving criteria for the use of biomass established by Directive (EU) 2018/2001, with any necessary adjustments for application under this Directive, as set out in the implementing acts referred to in Article 14 of this Directive, shall be zero.’;</p>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="96%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">(c)</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">the following part is added:</p>
                                    <p id="d1e726-196-1" class="oj-ti-grseq-1">
                                             ‘PART C</p>
                                    <p id="L_2023130EN.01019601-g-001-0003" class="oj-ti-grseq-1">
                                       <span class="oj-bold">Monitoring and reporting of emissions corresponding to the activity referred to in Annex III</span>
                                    </p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Monitoring of emissions</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Emissions shall be monitored by calculation.</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Calculation</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Emissions shall be calculated using the following formula:</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Fuel released for consumption × emission factor</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Fuel released for consumption shall include the quantity of fuel released for consumption by the regulated entity.</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Default IPCC emission factors, taken from the 2006 IPCC Inventory Guidelines or subsequent updates of those Guidelines, shall be used unless fuel-specific emission factors identified by independent accredited laboratories using accepted analytical methods are more accurate.</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">A separate calculation shall be made for each regulated entity, and for each fuel.</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Reporting of emissions</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Each regulated entity shall include the following information in its report:</p>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">A.</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">Data identifying the regulated entity, including:</p>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">name of the regulated entity;</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">its address, including postcode and country;</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">type of the fuels it releases for consumption and its activities through which it releases the fuels for consumption, including the technology used;</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">address, telephone, fax and email details for a contact person; and</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">name of the owner of the regulated entity, and of any parent company.</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">B.</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">For each type of fuel released for consumption and which is used for combustion in the sectors referred to in Annex III, for which emissions are calculated:</p>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">quantity of fuel released for consumption;</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">emission factors;</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">total emissions;</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">end use(s) of the fuel released for consumption; and</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                                   <col width="4%"/>
                                                   <col width="96%"/>
                                                   <tbody>
                                                      <tr>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">—</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                         <td valign="top"  >
                                                            <p class="oj-normal">uncertainty.</p>
                                                         </td>
                                                      </tr>
                                                   </tbody>
                                                </table>
                                                <p class="oj-normal">Member States shall take measures to coordinate reporting requirements with any existing reporting requirements in order to minimise the reporting burden on businesses.’;</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
            <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
               <col width="4%"/>
               <col width="96%"/>
               <tbody>
                  <tr>
                     <td valign="top"  >
                        <p class="oj-normal">(5)</p>
                     </td>
                     <td valign="top"  >
                        <p class="oj-normal">In Annex V to Directive 2003/87/EC, the following part is added:</p>
                        <p id="d1e816-196-1" class="oj-ti-grseq-1">
                                 ‘PART C</p>
                        <p id="L_2023130EN.01019601-g-002-0004" class="oj-ti-grseq-1">
                           <span class="oj-bold">Verification of emissions corresponding to the activity referred to in Annex III</span>
                        </p>
                        <p class="oj-normal">General Principles</p>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">1.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>Emissions corresponding to the activity referred to in Annex III shall be subject to verification.</span>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">2.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verification process shall include consideration of the report pursuant to Article 14(3) and of monitoring during the preceding year. It shall address the reliability, credibility and accuracy of monitoring systems and the reported data and information relating to emissions, and in particular:</span>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(a)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the reported fuels released for consumption and related calculations;</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(b)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the choice and the employment of emission factors;</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(c)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the calculations leading to the determination of the overall emissions.</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">3.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>Reported emissions may only be validated if reliable and credible data and information allow the emissions to be determined with a high degree of certainty. A high degree of certainty requires the regulated entity to show that:</span>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(a)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the reported data are free of inconsistencies;</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(b)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the collection of the data has been carried out in accordance with the applicable scientific standards; and</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(c)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the relevant records of the regulated entity are complete and consistent.</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">4.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verifier shall be given access to all sites and information in relation to the subject of the verification.</span>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">5.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verifier shall take into account whether the regulated entity is registered under the Union eco-management and audit scheme (EMAS).</span>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Methodology</p>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Strategic analysis</p>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">6.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verification shall be based on a strategic analysis of all the quantities of fuels released for consumption by the regulated entity. This requires the verifier to have an overview of all the activities through which the regulated entity is releasing the fuels for consumption and their significance for emissions.</span>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Process analysis</p>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">7.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verification of the data and information submitted shall, where appropriate, be carried out on the site of the regulated entity. The verifier shall use spot-checks to determine the reliability of the reported data and information.</span>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Risk analysis</p>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">8.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verifier shall submit all the means through which the fuels are released for consumption by the regulated entity to an evaluation with regard to the reliability of the data on the overall emissions of the regulated entity.</span>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">9.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>On the basis of this analysis the verifier shall explicitly identify any element with a high risk of error and other aspects of the monitoring and reporting procedure which are likely to contribute to errors in the determination of the overall emissions. This especially involves the calculations necessary to determine the level of the emissions from individual sources. Particular attention shall be given to those elements with a high risk of error and the abovementioned aspects of the monitoring procedure.</span>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">10.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verifier shall take into consideration any effective risk control methods applied by the regulated entity with a view to minimising the degree of uncertainty.</span>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Report</p>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">11.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verifier shall prepare a report on the validation process stating whether the report pursuant to Article 14(3) is satisfactory. This report shall specify all issues relevant to the work carried out. A statement that the report pursuant to Article 14(3) is satisfactory may be made if, in the opinion of the verifier, the total emissions are not materially misstated.</span>
                                    <p class="oj-normal">Minimum competency requirement for the verifier</p>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="4%"/>
                           <col width="92%"/>
                           <tbody>
                              <tr>
                                 <td valign="top"  />
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <p class="oj-normal">12.</p>
                                 </td>
                                 <td valign="top"  >
                                    <span>The verifier shall be independent of the regulated entity, carry out his or her activities in a sound and objective professional manner, and understand:</span>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(a)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the provisions of this Directive, as well as relevant standards and guidance adopted by the Commission pursuant to Article 14(1);</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(b)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the legislative, regulatory, and administrative requirements relevant to the activities being verified; and</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                    <table width="100%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
                                       <col width="4%"/>
                                       <col width="96%"/>
                                       <tbody>
                                          <tr>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">(c)</p>
                                             </td>
                                             <td valign="top"  >
                                                <p class="oj-normal">the generation of all information related to all the means through which the fuels are released for consumption by the regulated entity, in particular, relating to the collection, measurement, calculation and reporting of data.’.</p>
                                             </td>
                                          </tr>
                                       </tbody>
                                    </table>
                                 </td>
                              </tr>
                           </tbody>
                        </table>
                     </td>
                  </tr>
               </tbody>
            </table>
         </div>
      </div>
      <hr class="oj-doc-end"/>
